summary: Wi-Fi above the radio: the installed system, a wsim radio carried by wsimrelay, joining the access points of the Linux AP guest's mac80211_hwsim radios in each security they offer and keeping its network as they change, each case a boot of the guest and the station that tests/cases/machine/wifi_scenario.c drives

cases.behavior: the installed system joins WPA2-Personal network A with wifi connect, takes a lease, resolves the endpoint through the AP's DNS, pings the AP and echoes 256 KiB to the host through it, and iw and /proc/net/wireless describe the radio and the link

execution.cleanup: libetude-case ends both machines and the service if they still run, and removes the evidence after a pass

steps.does: start hostpeer's TCP and UDP echo on the case's port 3, the endpoint 10.0.2.2 that the AP's DNS names endpoint.wifi.test
boot the Linux AP guest to its shell, start network A's access points in the case's first profile and its relay to the station's port 1
boot the station, pull its cable out through QMP, log in as root at the console, give eth1 10.0.4.15 and start wsimrelay to the guest's port 0
wifi scan, then wifi connect rach2-net with its passphrase, wait for the kernel's record of the lease 192.168.71.50, and read route -n and resolv.conf
nslookup endpoint.wifi.test, ping ap.wifi.test and send 256 KiB of random bytes through nc to the endpoint's echo
read iw dev, iw phy, iw dev wlan0 scan, iw dev wlan0 link, /proc/net/wireless and wpa_cli status

services.does: echo each TCP connection and UDP datagram on the case's port 3 until stopped

assertions.checks: wifi scan lists rach2-net with WPA2 and rach2-other
wifi connect says `wifi: connected to rach2-net`
the default route is through 192.168.71.1 on wlan0 at metric 600, and resolv.conf names 192.168.71.1
nslookup gives endpoint.wifi.test the address 10.0.2.2
ping ap.wifi.test has its 3 replies
the 262144 bytes that come back from the echo are those sent
iw dev shows wlan0 managed on rach2-net
iw phy shows phy0 with 2412 MHz, CCMP and the managed mode
iw dev wlan0 scan shows the three BSSIDs and rach2-other
iw dev wlan0 link shows the AP, rach2-net, a signal and the DTIM period
/proc/net/wireless has wlan0's line with a signal level
wpa_supplicant is still COMPLETED

progress.means: a step of the manifest has ended

native.reason: the station's radio is wsim, whose frames reach the Linux AP guest's mac80211_hwsim radios only through the two QEMU user networks' UDP forwards

cases.behavior: the installed system keeps network A through group rekeys, and its lease through a restart of the AP, a deauthentication and a channel switch of both access points, gives the lease up with the AP gone and joins again when it is back, and a roam with an SSH session kept, moves to and from network B, and lets the cable take and give back the default route and DNS

execution.cleanup: libetude-case ends both machines and the service if they still run, and removes the evidence after a pass

steps.does: start hostpeer's TCP and UDP echo on the case's port 3, the endpoint 10.0.2.2 that the AP's DNS names endpoint.wifi.test
boot the Linux AP guest to its shell, start network A's access points in the case's first profile and its relay to the station's port 1
boot the station, pull its cable out through QMP, log in as root at the console, give eth1 10.0.4.15 and start wsimrelay to the guest's port 0
wifi connect rach2-net, whose AP makes a new group key every 5 s, and wait for the lease
wait for the station's next group rekey, then flush the guest's neighbours and ping the station
wifiap start wpa2 again, wait for the station to join again, and read the station's console since the step began
deauthenticate the station from both APs of network A, wait for it to join again, and read the station's console since the step began
stop the guest's dnsmasq, run the station's wpa_action for two rejoins, resume dnsmasq and wait for the renewal's answer
three times, stop the DHCP client, run wpa_action for a disconnection and for a CONNECTED a second later, as its wait sees the join, and count the clients

start a ping from the station, switch both APs of network A to channels 3 and 8 five beacons ahead with transmit held, wait for wpa_supplicant's channel switch event and the ping's end, and read the station's console since the step began
wifiap stop a, wait for the disconnection and for the lease to be given up and read the routes, then start it and wait for the station to join again
open an SSH session to the station's own server through the guest's forward, send a line, wpa_cli roam to the other BSSID, and send another
wifi connect rach2-other, then wifiap stop b and wait for the station to go back to rach2-net by itself
plug the cable in through QMP, wait for its route, read the routes and servers and echo through it, then pull it out and read them again

services.does: echo each TCP connection and UDP datagram on the case's port 3 until stopped

assertions.checks: the station joins, with network A's routes and server, and echoes
the station logs a group rekey, answers the guest's broadcast ARP and echoes
after the restart the station joins again, with network A's routes and server, and echoes
through the restart the station kept its lease: the kernel recorded no loss of wlan0's IPv4 address
after the deauthentication the station joins again, with network A's routes and server, and echoes
through the deauthentication the station kept its lease, with no loss of wlan0's IPv4 address recorded, and the kernel logged that the AP deauthenticated it, with the reason
a rejoin inside the wait for an earlier renewal's answer keeps the lease: the kernel recorded no loss of wlan0's IPv4 address
a CONNECTED and a wait that sees the join at the same moment start one DHCP client between them

as network A's access points switch channels with transmit held, the station follows its own: wpa_supplicant reports the switch and no disconnection, the kernel logs it with no leave and no loss of wlan0's IPv4 address, a ping running across it is answered, and the station keeps network A's routes and server and echoes
with network A gone the station disconnects, gives its lease up and has no route on wlan0
with network A back the station joins again, with its routes and server, and echoes
the station is COMPLETED on the other BSSID and the SSH session carries both lines
the station joins rach2-other with its route and server alone, and echoes
with rach2-other gone the station joins rach2-net by itself, with its routes and server, and echoes
with the cable in, eth0 has the default route at metric 100 beside wlan0's at 600, resolv.conf names 10.0.2.3, and an echo goes through it
with the cable out the routes and server are network A's alone, and an echo goes over Wi-Fi
